text: 选择纳德尔曼博士的男性或女性角色卡，然后依照原书分配技能点。角色卡列出短柄斧、猎刀和步枪的武器数据，但没有打印持有数量；请登记队伍起始总数并分配，系统会记录每人的原始数量供后文恢复。

en.title: Create Investigator
text: Choose the male or female Dr. Nadelmann sheet, then allocate skills as directed by the book. The character sheets list hatchet, knife and rifle weapon profiles but print no quantities; register the expedition totals and distribute them. The runtime records each person’s starting quantities for later restoration.
